desc: On 13 March 1962 the Joint Chiefs of Staff sent the Secretary of Defense a memorandum forwarding a set of fabricated pretexts that would justify American military intervention in Cuba, and the Chairman, Gen. L. L. Lemnitzer, signed it. Its annex is headed 'PRETEXTS TO JUSTIFY US MILITARY INTERVENTION IN CUBA' and proposes, among other courses of action, blowing up a US ship in Guantanamo Bay and blaming Cuba, and substituting a duplicate aircraft at Eglin Air Force Base for a civil airliner belonging to a CIA proprietary company so that its apparent destruction could be attributed to Cuba. The board argues that cover stories are constructed deliberately at institutional level; this is the declassified instance of exactly that, drafted, staffed and signed at the top of the military chain, and released only because a records statute reached it in 1997. It belongs on the board as a document, not as an assertion about any other case.

dossier.narrative: The value of this document to this board is that it removes a step from the argument. The board does not have to establish that the United States government is willing to plan a deception and attribute it to somebody else, because the Joint Chiefs wrote one down and the Chairman signed it. The annex says in its own words that 'Since it would seem desirable to use legitimate provocation as the basis for US military intervention in Cuba a cover and deception plan ... could be executed as an initial effort to provoke Cuban reactions.' Its courses of action include blowing up a US ship in Guantanamo Bay and blaming Cuba, and painting and numbering an aircraft at Eglin AFB as an exact duplicate of a civil registered aircraft belonging to a CIA proprietary organisation in the Miami area. The memorandum also asks for the mission: paragraph 3 recommends that responsibility for both overt and covert military operations be assigned to the Joint Chiefs of Staff. What is on this board is the document and nothing beyond it. Northwoods says nothing about unidentified aerial phenomena and is not offered as evidence about any other case; it is offered as the proven floor of what the institution will put on paper. There is no Lemnitzer person node, deliberately: the signature block is on the document and the document carries him.
